title: Under Cabinet paper towel holder 15-Inch Solid Brass Traditional | Prestige Regal Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade cabinet space with an under-cabinet paper towel holder crafted from solid brass, designed to keep counters clear while staying easy to reach. Part of the prestige regal collection for a coordinated, traditional look.

Highlights:
- Under-cabinet mount helps keep countertops clutter-free
- Solid brass construction for enduring, traditional style
- Left- or right-hand opening for flexible placement
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean install
- Includes paper towel holder and all installation hardware

Specs:
- Collection: Prestige Regal
- Category: Paper Towel Holders
- Style: Traditional
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Cabinet mount
- Dimensions: 15-Inch L x 7-Inch H x 2.5-Inch W
- Weight: 3.2 lb
- Screws: #8 x 1 1/4
- Assembly required: No
- Finish options: available in a wide variety of designer finishes
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Coordinate with matching prestige regal pieces to complete a classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware look.

_previous.title: Prestige Regal Under Cabinet Paper Towel Holder
_previous.description: Attractive design brings together a touch of style and efficiency to your kitchen. This solid brass paper towel holder can be mounted under the cabinet with a left or right hand opening and will accommodate the extra depth of today's super-sized paper towel rolls. This simple counter-saving design fits any décor, is easy to load, keeps counters clutter-free, and is available in 14 contemporary and traditional finishes.
